title: Cardboard Box Solar Cooker Blueprint
problem: Amma spends hours coughing over firewood smoke in our small kitchen when gas cylinder prices go beyond our family budget.
idea: A simple building guide for a cardboard box solar cooker, and a checker to see if your cooker is built well.

items.title: Get two boxes
items.text: One big cardboard box and one smaller box that fits inside with a gap.
items.te: ఒక పెద్ద, ఒక చిన్న అట్టపెట్టె తీసుకోండి.

items.title: Fill the gap
items.text: Stuff newspaper in the gap between the boxes to keep heat in.

items.title: Shine the inside
items.text: Glue aluminium foil on the inside walls of the small box.
items.te: చిన్న పెట్టె లోపల అల్యూమినియం ఫాయిల్ అతికించండి.

items.title: Black bottom
items.text: Put a black sheet or paint the bottom black to soak up heat.

items.title: Glass or plastic lid
items.text: Cover the top with clear glass or thick clear plastic.
items.te: పైన పారదర్శక గాజు లేదా ప్లాస్టిక్ మూత పెట్టండి.

items.title: Reflector flap
items.text: Make a foil-covered flap to throw sunlight into the box.
items.te: ఎండను లోపలికి పంపే ఫాయిల్ ఫ్లాప్ చేయండి.

items.title: Cook
items.text: Use a black pot with a lid. Keep it in the sun from 10 am to 2 pm. Use cloth to lift the hot pot!
items.te: నల్ల గిన్నె వాడండి. వేడి గిన్నెను బట్టతో పట్టుకోండి!

items.text: Placed in full sun, no shadows

bands.text: Great cooker! Try cooking rice or dal on a sunny day. ☀️

how: Ask Gemini for step-by-step instructions to make a box solar cooker.
Collect two boxes, foil, newspaper, black paper and a clear plastic sheet.
Build it with a teacher's help and test it with a thermometer in the sun.
Draw a simple labelled diagram in Canva for each step.
Try cooking something easy, like boiling eggs or making rice.
Share the Canva blueprint with families in your village.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Give me step-by-step instructions, in simple English and Telugu, to make a cardboard box solar cooker with aluminium foil, newspaper, black paint and a clear lid. Add safety tips about the hot pot.
